rangeIntro: Start from a comfortable note: we go down to the lowest and up to the highest note you can sing. The result stays in your profile so you can track your progress.
rangeNoTestsYet: No tests yet: your result will appear here.

@rangeSpanDetail.description: Range width followed by the total semitones, e.g. '2 octaves + 5 semitones (29 semitones)'. span is already localized.

@rangeDeltaShort.description: Compact signed change in semitones, e.g. '+2 st'.

rangeHowItWorksBody: Tap "Start the test" and sing a comfortable note, holding it for a moment: I'll recognize it and from there we go down one semitone at a time. You only move on when you hit the note; when you really can't reach it, tap "Low limit reached" (or skip that single note). Then we go up toward the high notes the same way. At the end your range is saved in your profile.
rangeSingThisNote: Sing this note (tap to hear it again)
rangeSingComfortable: Sing a comfortable note and hold it
rangeStartHoldHint: When the bar is full, that's your starting note.
rangeProgressBetter: {count, plural, =1{+1 semitone} other{+{count} semitones}} compared to your last test
rangeProgressSame: Same span as your last test
rangeProgressWorse: {count, plural, =1{-1 semitone} other{-{count} semitones}} compared to your last test

@rangeProgressWorse.description: count is the absolute number of semitones lost.

rangeProgressWorseEncouraging: {count, plural, =1{-1 semitone} other{-{count} semitones}} compared to your last test: it happens, your voice changes from day to day

@rangeProgressWorseEncouraging.description: count is the absolute number of semitones lost.

rangeSavedToProfile: Result saved to your profile: the test history shows your progress over time.
rangeCoachSkipped: No problem, let's try the next one.
rangeCoachSetup: Start from a comfortable note: we'll go down toward the low notes together.
rangeCoachFindingStart: Sing a comfortable note and hold it: I'll recognize it.
rangeCoachDescending: Sing the note: we're heading down.
rangeCoachAscending: Now let's go up toward the high notes!
rangeCoachRetry: Let's try again starting from a more comfortable note.
rangeMicDenied: Microphone permission denied: enable it in your system settings.
rangeAudioInitFailed: Audio not initialized: check the microphone and the SoundFont.
rangeNothingValidated: No notes validated: the test was not saved.
profileEmptyBody: Complete a workout: here you'll find your streak, accuracy, vocal range and history.
profileRangeDeltaUp: {count, plural, =1{+1 semitone} other{+{count} semitones}} vs. previous
profileRangeDeltaDown: {count, plural, =1{-1 semitone} other{-{count} semitones}} vs. previous

@profileRangeDeltaDown.description: count is the absolute number of semitones lost.

profileFullHistoryPro: Full history ({count, plural, =1{1 session} other{{count} sessions}}) with Intonia Pro
profileDeleteRangeBody: The test from {date} will be removed.
profileDeleteSessionBody: "{name}" from {date} will be removed from your stats, streak and vocal range.
profileStreakStart: Practice today to start your streak!
profileStreakKeep: Keep it up, don't break it!
